entry.summary: Celero Communications, a maker of networking chips, has raised $275 million in a funding round that values the startup at more than $3 billion, tapping into demand to improve the efficiency of AI data centers.

entry.title: AI Health Company Forus Raises $150 Million at a $3 Billion Value
entry.summary: Healthcare automation startup Forus has raised $150 million at a $3 billion valuation just months after completing a previous funding round. The Series C round was led by Bain Capital Ventures, a firm that has invested in the company since its early-stage funding. Accel, Thrive Capital, General Catalyst, Redpoint Ventures, BoxGroup and Pear VC also participated in the round, Forus said Tuesday.

entry.title: Goldman's Wheeler Says Volume of AI Debt May Pressure Spreads
entry.summary: The sheer volume of AI-related debt issuance could pressure spreads, according to Miriam Wheeler, global head of leveraged finance at Goldman Sachs. "If you look at the last couple weeks in the market on the non-IG [investment grade] side, we have seen some spread widening, particularly in the AI space," Wheeler tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Mistral AI Raises €3 Billion With Samsung Leading the Round
entry.summary: French artificial intelligence company Mistral AI is raising €3 billion ($3.49 billion) in a Series D funding round, with Samsung Electronics joining the round. Chief Executive Officer Arthur Mensch argues that the company is probably still undervalued and that macroeconomic reasons are starting to show that open source models will win. He speaks with Bloomberg’s Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)
